name: catalog-pane
description: A pane, opened with /catalog, that explains your Claude Code setup: the version with its changelog and the harness it runs in, and every skill, command, agent, mod, plugin, settings hook, MCP server and tool as a list, a gallery of cards or a sortable table, with where each comes from, its GitHub repository and stars, install date, usage, token cost, updates, a model-written note on what each is for, and buttons to insert, run, update, disable or uninstall.
